data.title: 红月卡莲 · 红莲整备台前的王牌凝视
data.description: 灯火通明的机甲整备库内，卡莲身穿红莲紧身驾驶服单手扶着头盔，微汗的发丝贴在额角，身后的红莲机体巍峨耸立，少女目光炯炯自信。
data.action: holding pilot helmet, resting against railing, proud confident smile
data.lighting: crisp hangar floodlights reflecting off red armor and sleek suit
data.mood: proud and heroic ace pilot vibe
data.promptProse: Inside a bustling Knightmare hangar in front of the crimson Guren, Kallen Stadtfeld holds her helmet at her waist, red hair glistening under the floodlights with a confident smirk.
data.animaCaption: Kallen holding her helmet with a proud smile in the mecha hangar.
